name: abu
description: Agentic Brand Universe (ABU) skills: build and grow a typed, git-versioned brand universe by talking to your harness. START HERE: `abu` (hand it nothing and it reports where you stand, the highest-leverage next move, and a ten-minute one if you are bored) and `onboard` (installs everything and reports in plain language; never shows the user a command). generic tools for building and growing any brand/story universe (a typed, git-versioned, self-contained canon on the agenticstory engine). LIFECYCLE: start-new-story-universe (stand up a new universe with identity + register). AUTHORING (scaffold a typed entity + its reference-matrix slots): add-character, add-setting, add-visual-metaphor, add-motif, add-prop, add-story, add-relation. QUICK (no universe needed): create-style-pack (scaffold a portable Style Pack (SPEC 4.7) = pack.json + refs/ + a read-back gate, so a look becomes reusable and gated), create-lookbook (scaffold a Lookbook (SPEC 4.7.1) = the complement of a Style Pack: a curated but intentionally VARIED visual vocabulary - a wardrobe/fashion, a range of faces or building silhouettes - with a varietyRule + a variety gate, for what must stay on-aesthetic yet DIFFER per instance; motif/prop force sameness, a Style Pack is a medium; bound to a universe via a craft-canon register-rule that names it), on-brand-image (generate ONE image from a portable Style Pack (SPEC 4.7) - refs + palette + rejected poles + a read-back gate - for the common 'here is a folder of images, make more like them' case: deck plates, page heroes, icons; optionally takes a locked canon master so a recurring element stays identical). ART: shoot-references (SHOOT an entity's reference matrix: generate the art, read it back against the entity's invariants, then lock the passers with provenance; renamed from lock-references 2026-07-26 because that named the bookkeeping instead of the work), compose-spread (the atomic per-spread unit: canon-resolve + a deterministic prompt/refs assembler from canon that computes negatives from the selected looks so a per-book file can never contradict a character's canon alt-look, then generate + read-back), render-book (render a story into a picture book, reading identity + craft-canon; invokes compose-spread per spread), cover (the cover), update-book (edit an existing book; invokes compose-spread per touched spread). GATES (anti-drift forcing functions): canon-resolve (resolve refs before any render), render-readback (crop-zoom invariants after every render), casting-sweep (reuse-first before naming), voice-gate (voice-check before words/audio lock). Every canon skill takes a target universe and reads its universe.json identity + canon; none hardcodes a universe. on-brand-image is the exception by design: it takes a Style Pack path and needs no universe at all. META (evolve the framework itself): pave-the-path - the RETROSPECTIVE sweep, wired in as the LAST STEP of make-a-book's chain (publish -> land -> pave) so it fires on every book rather than waiting to be remembered, and it INTEGRATES BY DEFAULT rather than filing suggestions: read the diff and the scratchpad (never memory), find the hand-rolled code and repeated manual steps that WILL recur, and route the ones that pass its bar into deterministic substeps. Its bar is a naming sentence ('I hand-rolled X and the next invocation that needs X is Y'), it classifies each candidate PAVE/GATE/BUG/GUIDANCE/LEAVE, it records what it DECLINED, and it never edits the framework itself: it dispatches to evolve-abu, which keeps 'not yet' free. Distinct from fix-the-generator (the in-the-moment reflex) and from evolve-abu - invoke mid-session when you catch yourself hand-rolling framework-shaped work (a bespoke generate/provenance script, a missing scaffolder like create-style-pack, a look with no Style Pack); it promotes the hand-rolled thing UP into a skill/engine/spec, bumps the version, re-syncs + delivers the plugin, logs it, and updates itself. Nation of Fire is the reference implementation. Spec + engine live in the agenticstory repo (agenticstory.wiki). AGENT (dispatch for any framework-shaped task): agenticstory-steward - a framework-aware subagent whose whole job is to reach for the right verb instead of hand-rolling and to FLAG (never silently work around) gaps where the framework cannot yet do something sensible, escalating them to evolve-abu. HEALTH: universe-doctor - grade how COMPLETE and high-quality a universe is on a fixed rubric (identity, entity reference matrices, setting size-contracts, provenance, craft-canon, stories, self-containment), returning a letter grade + per-dimension scores + a prioritized punch-list naming the framework verb that closes each gap; the rubric is the framework's definition of a done, good universe (complements validate + lint-universe). (universe-doctor also defines DOCTOR MODE: an autonomous loop that keeps grading and improving a universe with the right verbs, texting the operator each gain, until told to stop.) book-doctor - grade a RENDERED book on local disk against what its render-spec declares, before it is delivered anywhere: every declared spread exists, the ENDCAPS (front cover and closing plate) are portrait while interiors are landscape, every asset carries its provenance recipe, no spread was generated from another spread render, and optionally every cast entity is registered and locked; delivery-agnostic by design (no bucket, no CDN, no network), so it complements rather than replaces a delivery platform's own probe, and its provenance + self-reference checks are ones a delivery probe structurally cannot do because recipes never ship. LANDING: land-work (merge a finished work branch home in ANY git repo instead of leaving it parked; classifies the target branch as free/idle/busy so it never moves a branch out from under a live sibling worktree, and QUEUES a blocked merge so the next run drains it; also prunes worktrees whose branch is already merged).
